what: Energy accounting through the fixture runner (P1-S04b, plan §13b.1): a car at 14 m/s loses its front bumper, a door and a wheel on the same tick, with every kick in the authorised-work ledger. `energyGainJ`, the most kinetic + potential energy minus the ledger ever rose above its start, stays under the solver's tolerance (it falls: friction and the ground take energy, nothing makes it). The cars wait out spawn protection first; the second car sits parked as a bystander. It ends at tick 500, inside R121's 2 s wheel-loss grace (the wheel goes at 270), so no wreck's respawn mixes into the ledger.
